name: Bvlgari Hotel London
positioning: Luxury hotel in Knightsbridge with a spa, colonnaded pool and suites close to Hyde Park, Harrods and Harvey Nichols
best_for: Travelers who want a Knightsbridge base close to Hyde Park and Harrods
Guests who want a hotel spa with a colonnaded pool and wellness treatments

facts.text: The hotel is in Knightsbridge, one block from Hyde Park and steps from Harvey Nichols and Harrods.
Condé Nast Traveler lists a bar, gym, pool and wifi among the hotel's amenities.
The hotel has a colonnaded swimming pool with loungers and cabanas, clad in textured Vicenza stone.
A separate vitality pool has full body massage jets and is finished with tiny tiles of gold leaf glass.
The Bvlgari Spa offers hyperbaric oxygen therapy and a Zerobody dry float experience.
Deluxe Rooms have a black Marquina marble bathtub and a separate shower.
All Deluxe Rooms have a Nespresso coffee machine and complimentary wireless Internet.
Knightsbridge Suites have black marble bathrooms and subtle nautical design cues.
The Ballroom occupies an entire floor of the hotel and is reached by dedicated lifts from the lobby.
Bvlgari Suite I has a fireplace, a bar, an office and a Marquina marble bath.

highlights.text: Knightsbridge Suites have views over Knightsbridge towards Hyde Park.
The hotel has a Private Cinema dedicated to Sir Richard Attenborough, with 4K resolution in 2D or Dolby 3D.
Guests of Bvlgari Suite I are given a private butler.
The Bvlgari Spa offers bespoke WORKSHOP training programs.
The Ballroom is licensed for wedding ceremonies.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes an intimate boutique size with limited availability.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Bvlgari Hotel London
